name: Apparel, Footwear and Lifestyle

seo.title: Reconciliation for Apparel and Footwear Brands | VipraTech
seo.description: Marketplace settlements, large-format store margins and markdown support, COD and returns, reconciled for apparel, footwear and lifestyle brands.

hero.headline: Reconcile marketplaces, store chains and returns in one place
hero.subheadline: Marketplace settlements and returns, department store margins and markdown support, website COD and refunds, and credit notes to retailers.

intro: Apparel, footwear and lifestyle brands sell through marketplaces, department and large-format stores, multi-brand outlets and their own websites, with high return rates and end-of-season markdowns. Store chains settle on agreed margins, often on sale-or-return terms, and ask for markdown support. Marketplaces settle net of commissions and returns. Every channel needs reconciling at size and colour level.

challenges.title: High return rates
challenges.detail: Customer and store returns are frequent, and some never come back to the warehouse.

challenges.title: Sale-or-return terms
challenges.detail: Store chains pay on sales rather than dispatches, and return unsold stock at season end.

challenges.title: Markdown support
challenges.detail: Retailers deduct markdown and promotion support agreed for end-of-season sales.

challenges.title: Many SKUs
challenges.detail: Size and colour variants multiply every reconciliation.

use_cases.note: Marketplace settlements tied to orders, with commission overcharges and missing returns found.
Department and large-format store payments checked against agreed margins, sale-or-return terms and markdown support.
Website orders matched to gateway settlements, COD remittances and returns.
Credit notes for returns and markdown support matched to approvals and retailer ledgers.

documents: Store chain sales reports and payment advice
Website orders, gateway settlements and COD remittances

faqs.q: Can it work at size and colour level?
faqs.a: Yes. Orders, returns and store sales are matched at SKU level, including size and colour variants.

faqs.q: Our store chains pay on sell-through. Does that work?
faqs.a: Yes. Sale-or-return terms are configured per chain, and payments are checked against their sales reports and returns.
Distributor claims settlement is live. The marketplace, store chain and COD workflows are in early access with design partners.
